units.source_text: 邸内有些地方还须修理。

en.t: Some places within the residence still needed repairs.

units.source_text: 源氏公子召集本来留在这里的及新近增添的人员，吩咐他们分别办理。

en.t: Prince Genji gathered both those who had originally remained there and the newly added staff, and ordered them to handle the work separately.

units.source_text: 在附近领地内当差的人们听见公子要来桂院，聚集在院内恭候，

en.t: The people serving on the nearby estates heard that the prince was coming to the Katsura estate, and gathered inside the compound to wait respectfully,

units.source_text: 现在都到这邸内来参见了。

en.t: and now they all came to this residence to pay their respects.

units.source_text: 公子命他们整理庭院中损坏的树木。

en.t: The prince ordered them to put the damaged trees in the garden in order.

units.source_text: 他说：“这院子里有好些装饰用的石头都滚下来不见了。

en.t: He said, “Many of the ornamental stones in this garden have rolled away and disappeared.

units.source_text: 若能整理得雅观，这也是个富有趣致的庭院。

en.t: If it can be arranged elegantly, this too will be a garden full of charm.

units.source_text: 不过这种地方过分修得讲究，也是枉然。

en.t: But it is pointless to make a place like this too elaborately refined.

units.source_text: 因为这不是久居之地，修得太好了，离去时依依难舍，反而增多痛苦。”

en.t: Because this is not a place where one will live for long; if it is made too fine, leaving it will become hard, and that will only increase the pain.”

units.source_text: 他就追述谪居明石浦时的往事，忽而欢笑，忽而泣下，随意畅谈，神情轩昂潇洒。

en.t: He then recalled the old days when he had lived in exile at Akashi Bay, laughing at times and shedding tears at times, speaking freely as he pleased, his manner noble and graceful.

units.source_text: 那尼姑窥见了他的风采，老也忘记了，忧也消解了，不禁笑逐颜开。

en.t: When the nun glimpsed his bearing, she forgot her age and her sorrows melted away, and she could not help breaking into a smile.
